P.title: Template:Data Lissandra/Iceborn Subjugation
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Iceborn Subjugation|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Lissandra |skill = I |icon = Iceborn Subjugation.png |blurb = {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever an enemy champion dies while {{ci|Lissandra}} is nearby, she spawns a ''Frozen Thrall'' from their corpse. |blurb2 = ''Frozen Thralls'' are {{tip|invulnerable}} and {{tip|untargetable}} ice spirits that {{tip|slow}} nearby enemies and gain increasing {{sti|ms|{{as|movement speed}}}} over their lifespan. They will chase nearby enemies for a few seconds before exploding, dealing {{as|magic damage}} in an area. |description = {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever a nearby enemy champion dies, '''Lissandra''' spawns a ''Frozen Thrall'' from their corpse.

''Frozen Thralls'' are ice spirits that have {{as|{{pp|325*.103;325*.242;325*.361;325*.461;325*.547;325*.619;325*.681;325*.733;325*.778;325*.812;325*.848;325*.876;325*.899;325*.919;325*.935;325*.95;325|0 to 4|type=seconds alive}} movement speed}} and {{tip|slow}} nearby enemies by 25%. They will chase nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemies for 4 seconds, prioritizing {{tip|champion|champions}}, after which they shatter to deal {{as|{{pplevel|120; then +20*x for 11; then +30*x|formula=100 + 20 per level until level 12, then +30 per level}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies. |effect radius= {{dv|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|1350|Aura radius around Lissandra for triggering the effect on enemy deaths, center-to-edge}}|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|450|Thrall slow field and explosion radius}}}} |targeting = Passive |affects = Enemies |damagetype = Magic |spelleffects = spellaoe |spellshield = true |notes = * ''Thralls'' are units that are considered champions (they are {{tip|clone|clones}}) and they take the form of the champion they arise from. ** Additionally, near the end of their life span, they will cue that champion's [[basic attack]] animation. ** They cannot be teleported by an allied {{ai|Realm Warp|Ryze}}. * ''Thralls'' are {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|invulnerable}}. * ''Thralls'' are revealed to enemies through the fog of war. * ''Thralls'' will continue to chase their target even if they enter a {{tip|brush}}. * ''Iceborn Subjugation'' will not summon a ''Thrall'' against enemy champions that enter a {{tip|zombie state}}, and will instead summon one after they've left the state. |yvideo = i81gZnoC-qA }}

E.name: Glacial Path
E.title: Template:Data Lissandra/Glacial Path
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Glacial Path|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Lissandra
|skill        = E
|icon         = Glacial Path.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Lissandra}} sends a claw of ice in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies it passes through. ''Glacial Path'' can be recast while the claw is active.
|blurb2      = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Lissandra''' {{tip|blinks}} to the claw.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lissandra''' sends a claw of ice in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies it passes through, decelerating over {{fd|1.25}} seconds. ''Glacial Path'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds while the claw is active.
|leveling     = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 210}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}}}
|description2 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Lissandra''' {{tip|blinks}} to the claw's current location, ending its trajectory.
|cooldown     = {{ap|24 to 12}}
|cdstart      = Starts on-cast
|cost         = {{ap|80 to 100}}
|costtype     = Mana
|speed        = {{tt|1200 - 640|Claw missile speed, decelerates over time}}
|range        = 1025
|width        = {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 250
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|targeting    = {{dv|[[Direction-targeted|Direction]]|[[Auto-targeted|Auto]]}}
|affects      = Enemies, Self
|damagetype   = magic
|projectile   = true
|spelleffects = aoe
|grounded = special
|onhiteffects = 
|spellshield  = True
|notes        = 
*Both casts count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* '''Lissandra''' can reactivate ''Glacial Path'' for the duration (plus another {{fd|0.2}}-{{fd|0.3}} seconds after the claw 'sinks' into the ground).
** The Claw can also hit enemies near the end point at this time, shortly after the missile has reached its maximum range.
* ''Glacial Path'' allows '''Lissandra''' to surpass through every single wall in all maps, so long as the claw is at least halfway through them.
* ''Glacial Path'' cannot be recast while {{tip|ground|grounded}} or {{tip|root|rooted}}.
* ''Glacial Path's'' endpoint shows through terrain, [[sight|fog of war]] and {{tip|brush}} to enemies within 600 range of it.
|yvideo       = HfSGNoehErg
}}

|champion     = Lissandra
|skill        = R
|icon         = Frozen Tomb.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Lissandra}} can cast ''Frozen Tomb'' on herself or an enemy champion.

|blurb3      = {{sbc|Self Cast:}} '''Lissandra''' instantly entombs herself in ice, entering {{tip|stasis (buff)|stasis}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds and {{tip|heal|healing}} herself over the duration based on {{as|her '''missing''' health}}.
|blurb4      = {{sbc|Frozen Tomb:}} ''Frozen Tomb'' creates a field of ice that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies and briefly {{tip|slow|slows}} them.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lissandra''' can cast ''Frozen Tomb'' on herself or an enemy champion.
|description2 = {{sbc|Enemy Cast:}} '''Lissandra''' freezes the target enemy champion, {{tip|knockdown|knocking them down}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
|description3 = {{sbc|Self Cast:}} '''Lissandra''' instantly entombs herself in ice, entering {{tip|stasis (buff)|stasis}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds and {{tip|healing}} herself every {{fd|0.25}} seconds over the duration. The healing is increased by {{as|{{pp|type='''missing''' health at the time of cast|key=%|0 to 100 for 11|key1=%|0 to 100|formula=1% per 1% of '''missing''' health}}}}.
|leveling3    = {{st|Minimum Heal per Tick|{{ap|100/10 to 200/10}} {{as|(+ {{ap|55/10}}% AP)}}|Maximum Heal per Tick|{{ap|100*2/10 to 200*2/10}} {{as|(+ {{ap|55*2/10}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Minimum Total Heal|{{ap|100 to 200}} {{as|(+ 55% AP)}}|Maximum Total Heal|{{ap|100*2 to 200*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|55*2}}% AP)}}}}
|description4 = ''Frozen Tomb'' creates a field of ice that spreads out from the target over {{fd|1.5}} seconds and covers the surrounding area for 3 seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for {{fd|0.5}} seconds, refreshing every {{fd|0.25}} seconds while they remain.
|leveling4    = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|150 to 350}} {{as|(+ 75% AP)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|45 to 75}}%}}
|cooldown     = {{ap|120 to 80}}
|cost         = 100
|costtype     = Mana
|cast time = {{dv|{{tt|{{fd|0.375}}|Enemy cast}}|{{tt|None|Self cast}}}}
|target range = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 550
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 550
|targeting    = Unit

|spelleffects = spellaoe
|onhiteffects =

|callforhelp  = true
|notes        = 
* Enemies can only be damaged by the field of ice once every 4 seconds.
** Under normal circumstances, this means once per cast of ''Frozen Tomb''.
* Enemies who come in contact with ''Frozen Tomb's'' slow field will be damaged and a small visual and sound effect will play.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the single-targeted portion and the radiating ice damage, but will not stop it from spreading.
* If the target becomes {{tip|untargetable}}, {{tip|death|dies}}, or is too far away during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on {{sti|cooldown}} nor pay its cost.
** The ability is not cancelled by loss of {{tip|sight}} of the target.
** This only applies to the enemy cast.
* When becoming {{tip|untargetable}}, '''Lissandra''' {{tip|homing projectile destruction|destroys}} enemy projectiles targeting her.
